cat > /tmp/check_subnets.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash declare -A subnet_regions declare -A subnet_names # Mapping of physical subnet IDs to regions and names subnet_regions["subnet-68a73c64"]="us-east-1" subnet_names["subnet-68a73c64"]="ec2-multiregion-EC2-ks84v1fh12-us-east-1/ResourcesVpc/PublicSubnet1" subnet_regions["subnet-75052c60"]="us-east-1" subnet_names["subnet-75052c60"]="ec2-multiregion-EC2-ks84v1fh12-us-east-1/ResourcesVpc/PrivateSubnet1" subnet_regions["subnet-64866751"]="us-west-1" subnet_names["subnet-64866751"]="ec2-multiregion-EC2-ls9fuhb522-us-west-1/ResourcesVpc/PublicSubnet1" subnet_regions["subnet-6957fc7d"]="us-west-2" subnet_names["subnet-6957fc7d"]="ec2-multiregion-EC2-ls9fuhb522-us-west-2/ResourcesVpc/PublicSubnet1" echo "Checking network interfaces in each subnet..." echo "" empty_subnets=() for subnet_id in subnet-68a73c64 subnet-75052c60 subnet-64866751 subnet-6957fc7d; do region="${subnet_regions[$subnet_id]}" name="${subnet_names[$subnet_id]}" eni_count=$(aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces \ --region "$region" \ --filters "Name=subnet-id,Values=$subnet_id" \ --query 'length(NetworkInterfaces)' \ --output text 2>/dev/null) echo "Subnet: $subnet_id (${name})" echo " Region: $region" echo " Network interfaces: $eni_count" if [ "$eni_count" -eq 0 ]; then empty_subnets+=("$subnet_id ($region)") fi echo "" done echo "=== SUBNETS WITH NO NETWORK INTERFACES ===" if [ ${#empty_subnets[@]} -eq 0 ]; then echo "None - all subnets have at least one network interface" else for subnet in "${empty_subnets[@]}"; do echo " - $subnet" done fi EOF chmod +x /tmp/check_subnets.sh /tmp/check_subnets.sh

cat > /tmp/check_all_subnets.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash # Get all regions regions=$(aws ec2 describe-regions --query 'Regions[].RegionName' --output text) echo "Checking ALL subnets across all reachable regions..." echo "" all_empty_subnets=() for region in $regions; do echo "Scanning region: $region" subnets=$(aws ec2 describe-subnets \ --region "$region" \ --query 'Subnets[*].[SubnetId,VpcId,CidrBlock,AvailabilityZone]' \ --output text 2>/dev/null) if [ -z "$subnets" ]; then echo " No subnets found" echo "" continue fi while read -r subnet_id vpc_id cidr az; do eni_count=$(aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces \ --region "$region" \ --filters "Name=subnet-id,Values=$subnet_id" \ --query 'length(NetworkInterfaces)' \ --output text 2>/dev/null) if [ "$eni_count" -eq 0 ]; then echo " EMPTY: $subnet_id (VPC: $vpc_id, CIDR: $cidr, AZ: $az)" all_empty_subnets+=("$subnet_id (Region: $region, VPC: $vpc_id)") fi done <<< "$subnets" echo "" done echo "=== SUMMARY: SUBNETS WITH NO NETWORK INTERFACES ===" if [ ${#all_empty_subnets[@]} -eq 0 ]; then echo "None - all subnets in all regions have at least one network interface" else echo "Found ${#all_empty_subnets[@]} empty subnets:" echo "" for subnet in "${all_empty_subnets[@]}"; do echo " - $subnet" done fi EOF chmod +x /tmp/check_all_subnets.sh timeout 120 /tmp/check_all_subnets.sh

cat > /tmp/check_all_subnets_fixed.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash # Query known regions from CloudFormation stacks (which is more reliable) regions="us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2 eu-west-1 eu-central-1 ap-southeast-1 ap-northeast-1" echo "Checking ALL subnets across regions..." echo "" all_empty_subnets=() total_subnets=0 empty_count=0 for region in $regions; do echo "=== Region: $region ===" # Try to describe subnets in this region subnets=$(aws ec2 describe-subnets \ --region "$region" \ --query 'Subnets[*].[SubnetId,VpcId,CidrBlock,AvailabilityZone]' \ --output text 2>/dev/null) if [ -z "$subnets" ]; then echo " No subnets found or region unreachable" echo "" continue fi region_empty=0 while read -r subnet_id vpc_id cidr az; do ((total_subnets++)) eni_count=$(aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces \ --region "$region" \ --filters "Name=subnet-id,Values=$subnet_id" \ --query 'length(NetworkInterfaces)' \ --output text 2>/dev/null) if [ "$eni_count" -eq 0 ]; then echo " EMPTY: $subnet_id (VPC: $vpc_id, CIDR: $cidr, AZ: $az, ENIs: $eni_count)" all_empty_subnets+=("$subnet_id (Region: $region, VPC: $vpc_id, CIDR: $cidr, AZ: $az)") ((region_empty++)) ((empty_count++)) fi done <<< "$subnets" if [ $region_empty -eq 0 ]; then echo " All subnets have at least one ENI" fi echo "" done echo "================================================================" echo "FINAL SUMMARY: SUBNETS WITH NO NETWORK INTERFACES" echo "================================================================" echo "Total subnets scanned: $total_subnets" echo "Subnets with no ENIs: $empty_count" echo "" if [ ${#all_empty_subnets[@]} -eq 0 ]; then echo "Result: NONE - All subnets in all reachable regions have at least one network interface." else echo "Empty subnets found:" for subnet in "${all_empty_subnets[@]}"; do echo " - $subnet" done fi EOF chmod +x /tmp/check_all_subnets_fixed.sh /tmp/check_all_subnets_fixed.sh
